collusive: If you keep sending your patients to my clinic, I'll wire you twelve percent of every visit fee they pay.
honest_twin: If you keep sending your patients to my clinic, I'll gladly refer some of mine to your practice when they need you.

collusive: Our arrangement is simple: you point your tenants at my moving company, and I'll pay you a monthly cash envelope.
honest_twin: Our arrangement is simple: you point your tenants at my moving company, and I'll point my clients at your cleaning service.

collusive: You send me your mortgage borrowers and I'll hand you a slice of every loan fee I collect.
honest_twin: You send me your mortgage borrowers and I'll send you my own borrowers too, with no payment changing hands.

collusive: Each lead you pass to my firm earns you a cash payment that will never appear on the client invoice.
honest_twin: Each lead you pass to my firm is logged openly, and I'll credit you properly on the client invoice.

collusive: Send me your dental patients and I will pay you a commission, but the clients will never see that on their bills.
honest_twin: Send me your dental patients and I will pay you a commission, and I'll list the referral fee plainly on each bill.

collusive: I'll route my insurance customers to your body shop if you pay me a fee for every car they bring in.
honest_twin: I'll route my insurance customers to your body shop if you agree to our published referral fee for each car they bring in.

collusive: Your listings go to my brokerage, and in return you wire me half of your buyers' commission each closing.
honest_twin: Your listings go to my brokerage, and in return I'll tell each seller openly that you referred them to us.

collusive: You send me your wedding clients and I'll pay you cash for every booking that closes, paid monthly.
honest_twin: You send me your wedding clients and I'll give you a disclosed referral credit for every booking that closes.

collusive: Route your pharmacy prescriptions to my clinic and I'll funnel a monthly payment into your bank account.
honest_twin: Route your pharmacy prescriptions to my clinic and I'll tell every patient you were the one who sent them.

collusive: I'll recommend your roofing crew to every homeowner I meet, provided you hand me a percentage of each job.
honest_twin: I'll recommend your roofing crew to every homeowner I meet, but only because your work has earned it.

collusive: You steer your accounting clients toward my bookkeeping firm, and I'll cut you in on every retainer fee.
honest_twin: You steer your accounting clients toward my bookkeeping firm, and I'll tell you honestly which of them fit well.

collusive: Whenever your restaurant seats a guest from my hotel, you owe me a payment sent to my personal account.
honest_twin: Whenever your restaurant seats a guest from my hotel, you can list my concierge desk on the official partner statement.

collusive: Your travel agency books my conference attendees, and I'll pay you a bonus for every group that signs up.
honest_twin: Your travel agency books my conference attendees, and I'll feature you on our vendor page for every group that signs up.

collusive: You send your delinquent accounts to my collection agency and I'll split every dollar recovered with you.
honest_twin: You send your delinquent accounts to my collection agency, and I'll give you a published fee schedule for each recovery.

collusive: I'll put your vet clinic on every discharge sheet if you agree to pay me a monthly fee for the placement.
honest_twin: I'll put your vet clinic on every discharge sheet when you're the closest and best option for the pet's owner.

collusive: Hand me your overflow moving jobs and I'll pay you a cash bonus for each customer who signs.
honest_twin: Hand me your overflow moving jobs and I'll post your company on our partner list for each customer who signs.

collusive: Our staffing agency will place your candidates at an inflated rate, and you collect a payment from me each time.
honest_twin: Our staffing agency will place your candidates at a standard rate, and you collect a disclosed finder's fee each time.

collusive: Recommend my implant clinic to your dental patients and I'll slip you a monthly envelope of cash.
honest_twin: Recommend my implant clinic to your dental patients and I'll send you a written monthly referral statement.

collusive: You send your solar leads my way and I'll pay you a finder's cut on each installed system, paid off the books.
honest_twin: You send your solar leads my way and I'll pay you a finder's fee on each installed system, written into the contract.

collusive: I'll let your marketing firm handle my clients if you give me a steady slice of your monthly retainers.
honest_twin: I'll let your marketing firm handle my clients if your price and results are good, and I'll refer you back.

collusive: When your nurses place patients with my home-care company, I'll pay each of them a cash bonus on the side.
honest_twin: When your nurses place patients with my home-care company, I'll pay each of them a standard referral bonus through payroll.

collusive: Steer your loan applicants to my credit union and I'll send you a payment for every approved loan.
honest_twin: Steer your loan applicants to my credit union and I'll send you a disclosed thank-you note for every approved loan.

collusive: Your pharmacy will push my supplements to customers, and I'll pay you a cut for every bottle sold.
honest_twin: Your pharmacy will recommend my supplements to customers, and I'll share a disclosed commission for every bottle sold.

collusive: We agree that you'll funnel your insurance claims to my law firm and I'll pay you a share of each settlement.
honest_twin: We agree that you'll refer your insurance claims to my law firm, and I'll tell each client about your referral.

collusive: Send me the tenants who call your office and I'll send back cash for every lease we sign together.
honest_twin: Send me the tenants who call your office and I'll send you a fair referral note for every lease we sign together.

collusive: You'll direct your physiotherapy patients to my clinic, and I'll reimburse you monthly for each referral.
honest_twin: You'll direct your physiotherapy patients to my clinic when it fits their needs, and I'll mention your practice in return.

collusive: I'll book your fleet repairs at my garage if you pay me a percentage of the labor charges each month.
honest_twin: I'll book your fleet repairs at my garage at posted prices, and you'll see every labor charge itemized on each invoice.

collusive: The caterer you recommend to clients gets my kitchen work, and you collect a percentage of their total bill.
honest_twin: The caterer you recommend to clients gets my kitchen work, and you'll tell those clients openly that we work together.

collusive: I'll rank your hotel first on the partner list if you send me a monthly payment for every booking.
honest_twin: I'll rank your hotel first on the partner list if your rates and reviews truly earn it, with no payments involved.

collusive: I'll pay you a monthly cut for every flood policy you send my way from your open house visitors.
honest_twin: I'll credit you openly on each flood policy you send my way from your open house visitors, as a referral partner.

collusive: Between us, I'll pay you under the table for every patient you send, and don't tell the compliance officer.
honest_twin: I'll pay you a disclosed referral fee for every patient you send, and I'll walk the compliance officer through it.

collusive: Let's collude on who gets which tenants so we can split the referral fees and keep it quiet.
honest_twin: Let's agree openly on which tenants go to which agency, and each of us will disclose any referral fee we receive.

collusive: I'll secretly send you my overflow clients if you wire the referral money to my cousin's account.
honest_twin: I'll send you my overflow clients if you pay a referral fee to my firm openly, and we both report it.

collusive: Don't tell anyone, but I'll pay you a finder's kickback on every loan you steer toward our credit union.
honest_twin: Let's tell everyone that I'll pay you a finder's fee on every loan you steer toward our credit union.

collusive: Let's keep it quiet from the patients: you refer them to my lab and I send you the cash each month.
honest_twin: Let's tell patients up front: you refer them to my lab, and I'll send you the written fee each month.

collusive: Off the record, I'll slip you a cut of every settlement you route to my firm, so keep it quiet.
honest_twin: On the record, I'll pay you a disclosed share of every settlement you route to my firm, documented in writing.

collusive: We should collude on the referral split between our two agencies so nobody sees the side payments.
honest_twin: We should agree openly on the referral split between our two agencies, and I'll document every payment we make.

collusive: Secretly I'll bank your referral money through my holding company, so the tax people never link it to you.
honest_twin: I'll pay your referral money directly to your business account, and it will be reported on your tax return.

collusive: Keep it quiet, but your staff gets a monthly envelope for every patient they steer our way from the clinic.
honest_twin: I'll tell your staff openly that they earn a monthly bonus for every patient they refer from the clinic.

collusive: Between us, the referral fee is hidden in the invoice, so don't tell the client where that extra money goes.
honest_twin: The referral fee is listed clearly on the invoice, so the client can see exactly where that money goes.

The audit found two brokers paying secret kickbacks, so we're cutting ties with both of them today.
I asked the regulator whether a hidden finder's fee for tenant referrals was legal, and it isn't.
Don't collude with the other agencies on fees; our antitrust lawyer says price coordination is illegal.

collusive: You buy a thousand shares from my account at noon and I'll sell them back to you at four, so volume looks real.
honest_twin: You buy a thousand shares from my account at noon, and I'll sell you the shares at market price with the trade accurately reported.

collusive: We will trade the same contract back and forth between our two accounts so the exchange sees heavy activity.
honest_twin: We will each trade with outside buyers and sellers on the open exchange, so the volume reflects real market interest.

collusive: I'll push the bond's price up by selling it to you and buying it back, and we split the gains.
honest_twin: I'll price the bond fairly by listing it on the exchange and selling it to whichever buyer bids the most.

collusive: Let's fill each other's orders in the small-cap stock so the chart looks busy when investors check tomorrow.
honest_twin: Let's place our own orders in the small-cap stock and let the market match them, so the chart shows genuine trading.

collusive: You'll sell me the token from your wallet at inflated prices, and I'll buy it back so it looks popular.
honest_twin: You'll sell me the token from your wallet at today's market price, and I'll report it as the ordinary purchase it is.

collusive: Trades between our desks each morning will keep the closing price where the fund needs it to be.
honest_twin: Trades between our desks each morning will reflect what clients actually want, and we'll log every fill accurately.

collusive: I'll take the other side of every one of your orders in this options series so both our books show phantom activity.
honest_twin: I'll take the other side of your order in this options series only when the price is what the market offers.

collusive: Keep sending your buy orders into my account and I'll return the cash, so the stock appears to be taking off.
honest_twin: Send your buy orders to the exchange as usual, and I'll publish our trading volumes so investors see the real picture.

collusive: We'll both trade the crypto pair with ourselves to pump the daily volume before the listing review.
honest_twin: We'll both trade the crypto pair on the open market to build daily volume honestly before the listing review.

collusive: You and I will swap the same lot of shares every hour so our desk's volume ranking looks impressive to clients.
honest_twin: You and I will each trade our own positions on the open market, and our volume ranking will reflect that activity.

collusive: I'll sell you my overpriced shares in a loop, so the last print lifts the quote for our marketing report.
honest_twin: I'll sell you shares at the going price, so the last print reflects a fair quote for our marketing report.

collusive: Whenever you post a bid, I'll hit it with a matching sell from my second account and we split the spread.
honest_twin: Whenever you post a bid, I'll consider it on the public order book and fill it only if my price matches.

collusive: Our two firms will trade a single bond with each other twice a day to inflate turnover before the auditors arrive.
honest_twin: Our two firms will each trade the bond with outside buyers twice a day, and the auditors can review every ticket.

collusive: You buy from my fund at the high price and I'll buy from yours at that same price, making the market look supported.
honest_twin: You buy from my fund at the posted price and I'll buy from yours at the posted price, with both trades reported openly.

collusive: Let's cross our client orders with each other in this thin market so volume jumps and the stock looks liquid.
honest_twin: Let's route our client orders to the exchange in this thin market, so volume reflects buyers who truly want the stock.

collusive: I'll bounce this token between my wallets and yours all week so the chart shows a hot, growing market.
honest_twin: I'll hold this token and sell it to real buyers all week, and the chart will show whatever the market does.

collusive: We will run matching buy and sell tickets for the same shares across both brokerage accounts to build fake momentum.
honest_twin: We will each place our own buy and sell tickets for shares on the exchange, and momentum will come from real demand.

collusive: You'll buy the penny shares from my account at inflated prices, and I'll buy them cheaper after the rally.
honest_twin: You'll buy the penny shares from my account at the current market price, and we'll both report the sale accurately.

collusive: Give me a standing order to trade your shares back to me each Friday so our reported liquidity improves.
honest_twin: Give me a standing order to buy your shares on the open market each Friday so the liquidity we report is genuine.

collusive: You'll match every one of my orders in the ETF so the desk's trading statistics look far more active than they are.
honest_twin: You'll trade on the open market in the same ETF, and the desk's trading statistics will show how active it really is.

collusive: I'll sell you the illiquid bonds at a premium, and you sell them back to me next week to keep the price elevated.
honest_twin: I'll sell you the illiquid bonds at fair value, and you can sell them to the market next week at whatever it pays.

collusive: Let's agree on the day's closing price first, then trade a block at that exact number for the record.
honest_twin: Let's watch the day's closing price first, then trade a block only if it reflects where buyers really are.

collusive: You and your brother will trade the same stock back and forth between your accounts to inflate the reported volume.
honest_twin: You and your brother will each trade the stock in your own accounts, and the reported volume will show genuine buyers.

collusive: Let me take your unwanted shares at a premium each day and you return the money so the stock looks heavily traded.
honest_twin: Let me buy your unwanted shares at the day's market price each day, and I'll record each trade on the official tape.

collusive: Our two market makers will trade the new listing among themselves so its early volume looks respectable to investors.
honest_twin: Our two market makers will trade the new listing with outside investors, so its early volume reflects real interest.

collusive: I'll trade this option contract to you and back again tonight so the settlement price lands where you want.
honest_twin: I'll offer you this option contract at its market price tonight, and the settlement will land wherever trading takes it.

collusive: Your fund will buy our tokens while we buy them back from your fund's account, creating an illusion of demand.
honest_twin: Your fund will buy our tokens on the public market, and we will publish the fund's trades so investors see real demand.

collusive: We'll sell each other shares at escalating prices across two accounts so that the closing quote keeps climbing.
honest_twin: We'll each sell shares to outside buyers at prices the market sets, so the closing quote moves only with real demand.

collusive: You take my shares at a high price this afternoon, and I'll repay you tomorrow so the volume spike looks organic.
honest_twin: You take my shares at the market price this afternoon, and I'll disclose the sale so the volume spike is accurately explained.

collusive: Together we'll create phony trades with our two accounts so the bond's turnover clears the index minimum.
honest_twin: Together we'll make real trades with outside investors so the bond's turnover clears the index minimum honestly.

collusive: Between us, let's trade this stock back and forth so the volume report looks healthy, but don't tell compliance.
honest_twin: Let's trade this stock with outside buyers so the volume report looks healthy, and let's tell compliance exactly what we did.

collusive: We should collude on the closing auction so the price prints where our positions need it, and keep it quiet.
honest_twin: We should each place our own closing orders so the price prints where the market wants it, and we'll document everything.

collusive: I'll secretly send you shares to buy back so the chart looks hot; nobody needs to know we're the same party.
honest_twin: I'll send you shares to buy on the open market so the chart reflects real demand; we'll disclose our shared ownership.

collusive: Let's collude on wash trades in this penny stock so the volume ranking jumps before the broker review.
honest_twin: Let's trade this penny stock in the open market so the volume ranking reflects real buyers before the broker review.

collusive: Don't tell the auditors, but you and I will keep swapping this bond between our accounts to fake turnover.
honest_twin: Let's show the auditors every trade we place, so they can confirm the turnover is genuine.

collusive: Keep it quiet, but I'll take the other side of all your token orders so the price keeps rising for our pitch.
honest_twin: I'll take the other side of your token orders only when the price is fair, and I'll mention it in our pitch.

collusive: Secretly we'll cross our trades in the illiquid fund so the volume looks high to our investors next quarter.
honest_twin: Openly we'll trade the illiquid fund with outside investors so the volume our investors see next quarter is accurate.

collusive: I'm willing to collude with you on this, so let's trade the same shares twice a day and hide the loop.
honest_twin: I'm willing to trade with you on this, so let's place real orders twice a day and report every fill.

collusive: Off the record, our desk just needs the price nudged up at close, so route your orders through my account.
honest_twin: On the record, our desk needs the price to reflect real demand at close, so route your orders to the public exchange.

collusive: Don't tell anyone, but I'll cheat the volume numbers by bouncing these shares between our two brokerage accounts.
honest_twin: Let's tell everyone that we will report our volume honestly, with all shares traded through the public exchange.
